senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of אָחוֹר)to be behind, v. Pi.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 93a:4">B. Bath. 93ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 34a:18">Shebu. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 37b:3">Snh. 37ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. B. Bath. l. c. <cite ref="J00140"><he>יהיר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 3:6">Tosef. B. Kam. III, 6</cite> <he>אוֹחֵיר</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:9">Pes. IX, 9</cite> <he>אם אֵחַרְתִּי</he> if I should be late. Y. Yoma III, 40ᶜ top <he>א׳ בו מעשה</he> the text orders a later action after it. Y. Ned. X, 42ᵃ; 42ᵇ <he>א׳ בעמידה</he> he tarried in standing, i.e. was the last to sit down.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81:5">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>, beg. <he>א׳ אדם את נדרו</he> if one procrastinates the fulfillment of his vow; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be postponed, be done late, be placed later. Y. Yoma III, 40ᶜ top בכלל מְאוּחָר היה would belong to things to be done later.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>יוּאֲחַר וכ׳</he> let it be done later than &c.—<he>אין מוקדם ומאוחר בתורה</he> there is no ‘earlier’ or ‘later’ (no chronological order) in the events or laws of the Scripture.
<cite ref="Pesachim 6b">Pes. 6ᵇ</cite>; a. e.; Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵈ <he>מוּאֲחַר</he>.—
Shebi. X, 5, a. fr. מאוחר (a document) postdated, opp. מוקדם antedated.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:10">B. Mets. V, 10</cite> <he>רבית מְאוּחֶרֶת</he> postpaid interests.
